answer: Physical Enclave Continuity Check. Each agent identity is bound to a hardware enclave whose die is laser-etched with a unique fiber pattern; the enclave signs challenges only while its measured boot chain and that pattern stay unaltered. A hollow marketplace of cloned software identities fails because no two dies share a pattern. To mass-register, an attacker must buy and power distinct genuine chips, then thread each through a fresh provisioning terrace under operator control.
